signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

news.title: Walmart Invests in Base Power, Offers 20% Off Home Battery Installs in Texas
Walmart Backs Home Battery Startup Base Power
Base Power signs home energy supply deal with Walmart

bullets: Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and other GTM teams to understand gaps in the member-experience and user journey with Base.
Investigate product experiences that could improve the current user journey.
Explore and acquire what data we have and what data we might need to build better experiences.
Ship MVP experiences quickly and collect data to measure outcomes, success, and learnings.
Own and improve critical parts of Base’s acquisition, activation, and retention funnel: from first touch through long-term engagement.
Identify and execute large strategic bets that materially improve growth performance, scalability, or customer experience.
Build new growth products and systems from scratch, including self-serve flows, onboarding experiences, lifecycle products, referral systems, internal tooling, and funnel…
Partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, operations, and growth teams to ship high-quality customer experiences quickly.
Define and improve product measurement: instrumentation, events, funnels, experimentation frameworks, attribution hygiene, and operational reporting.
